needs_review.finding: After 15 searches rotating across countries (Africa, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, India, Latin America, Asia), roles (director, coordinator, missionary, staff), and common first names, only two named individuals were discovered in the /appeals/ path
needs_review.evidence: Search results consistently returned only Scott Rosene and Freddy Tuyizere; Global Launch Fund (a fund, not a person) appeared but was excluded per filter rules
needs_review.recommendation: The epray.yfci.org/appeals domain may have limited public indexing or a small subset of named personal giving pages. Verify with YFC if this represents the complete enumerable set or if other staff profiles exist behind authentication or under different URL structures
